title: Respiratory Support in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) Patients
brief_summary: The hypothesis of this study is that any of 3 modalities of home non- invasive ventilation (NIV) compared to 'no NIV' (=hospital NIV) will reduce re-admission to hospital or death in COPD patients who remain persistently hypercapnic following an exacerbation requiring NIV.
